**In one line**: Anthropic has reportedly hired Amir Salek, a chip veteran from Google, as part of a broader move into hardware.

### Key points
- According to The Economic Times, Anthropic has brought on Amir Salek, who built his chip-development career at Google.
- The hire is described as part of the company's push into hardware.
- For Anthropic, maker of the Claude models, it reads as a signal of interest in owning more of its infrastructure and silicon stack, not just software.

### Why it matters
Semiconductors are a decisive variable in the cost of training and serving large AI models. Securing a chip expert suggests Anthropic may be looking to reduce reliance on third-party GPUs and gain more control over cost and performance through its own hardware optimization.
